video_title: RJ Says He KNOWS LeBron's Real Plan... And He's Not Telling

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James's future team plans
quotes.excerpt: He told me exactly what was going to happen. He told me the date that he was going

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: He told me exactly what was going to happen. He told me the date that he was going to tell the Lakers that he moved on. Then he told me where he was going. He told me not to tell, but I know the whole plan. Me, him, and Rich Paul, we have been talking. So I kind of know their whole strategy.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: They are waiting on some other dominoes to fall, right, to make sure everything is aligned.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: You know how once he told the Lakers he was not coming back, they signed all the players the next day. So he is just waiting on a couple of things.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James's lack of a real plan
quotes.excerpt: This is the first time that I feel like that LeBron doesn't have a real plan.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: This is the first time that I feel like that LeBron doesn't have a real plan. And it is not in a bad way. This is the first time where he is actually saying, you know what, let me sit back and let me really make some decisions and see what is out there. Because usually, he has a plan in place.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: He got one plan, though. He got Bronny resigned before he left.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I get that. But when I am saying on where he is going, and I think where he is going, and that is the beauty of it. Because if I am teams around the league, if I am the Denver Nuggets, if I am Anthony Edwards, I am all jumping on the phone to call LeBron.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the teams LeBron James is considering
quotes.excerpt: Miami, Cleveland, Golden State are names teams that have been mentioned. Lakers were one of those teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Miami, Cleveland, Golden State are names teams that have been mentioned. Lakers were one of those teams. He is taking them out of the running, in my opinion.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: You think he goes to the Clippers?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Fuck no. It is available. A lot of things are available, but I am saying, think about it. He does not got to move. And if you win some, they ain't won shit over there. This is not the James Harden, Kawhi Leonard, this is not that.
